data.label: initial energy content of the egg
data.comment: Based on Redclaw crayfish (RodrGarc2006): egg diameter (2.22 mm) and energy (55.56 J/egg), egg diameter avg 2.8mm (2.4 to 3.4mm) (MaguKlob2005)

data.label: total length at puberty females
data.comment: Length at sexual maturity 3.5-5 cm, Parvulescu (2010) on Wiki, 5.8cm - 6.30cm on Medvednica (Croatia)  [MaguErbe2002], The smallest egg-bearing female was 6.42 cm long in DakiMagu2016

data.label: carapace length at puberty females
data.comment: puberty moult at a carapace length of about 26 mm

data.label: max reprod rate
data.comment: ['Reproduction in Sep/Oct, eggs of 3mm diameter, 50-100 per brood (EoL)

data.label: ultimate wet weight
data.comment: Max wet weight of females on Medvednica (Croatia) 38g in MaguErbe2002, 43g in DakiMagu2016

data.label: ultimate wet weight males
data.comment: Max wet weight of males on Medvednica (Croatia) 55g in MaguErbe2002, 72g in DakiMagu2016,  but the reported max wet weight on EoL is 100g (and similar length)!

data.label: age at birth
data.comment: After molting, feed on live invertebrates
